newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Bank of Korea to supply 500 bln won to banks.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Korea to supply 500 bln won to banks.

text.p: The Bank of Korea said it planned to supply 500 billion won to commercial banks on Wednesday through eight-day repurchase agreements (repos) to relieve a shortage in market liquidity.

"We have decided to release 500 billion won through eight-day repos because market participants are reacting too sensitively to a shortage of reserve requirements at banks, tightening the short-term money market," said an official at the central bank.
Money market dealers said call money was being quoted at around 14.3 percent in Wednesday morning, 30 basis points up from Tuesday's closing rate.
